why: A June 2025 HAL preprint by Idriss Aberkane claims a full 'low-tech' elementary proof that any ×2/×3-invariant ergodic measure is Lebesgue or atomic; the author has a history of self-published claimed solutions to famous problems (e.g. Collatz), so credibility is questionable but the claim itself is a post-snapshot event about this exact problem.
